caption: The drawing depicts a side view of a Victorian-style women's dress in shades of light brown, beige, and muted lavender with gray undertones. The dress features a fitted bodice with long sleeves and a high, ruffled neckline, as well as ruffled and pleated decorative trim along the collar, cuffs, and hem of the bodice. The skirt is full, extending outwards at the hips and tapering down with multiple horizontal bands of pleated fabric and fringed trim. The back of the skirt has an elaborate train with layered, scalloped, and pleated elements that fan out onto the floor. The overall design emphasizes textures and layers, with various sections separated by rows of contrasting trim and edging. The background is plain and uncolored, and the dress appears to be presented as a fashion plate or design sketch with no discernible figure wearing it.
title: Dress
